The average rate of change over an interval is defined as the total change in the value divided by the total change in time. It effectively corresponds to the slope of the secant line connecting the first and last points of the series.

Confidence level: 95%

```python
def avg_rate(series):
    if len(series) < 2:
        return "0.00"
    
    first_point = series[0]
    last_point = series[-1]
    
    delta_time = last_point[0] - first_point[0]
    delta_value = last_point[1] - first_point[1]
    
    if delta_time == 0:
        return "0.00"
        
    rate = delta_value / delta_time
    return f"{rate:.2f}"
```
